name: document-purge-parent-paths-2026-10-27

negativeControl.observed: Before the repair, replacing the trash directory immediately before unlink deleted the unrelated outside file with the same hidden name.

repair: Linux purge and retention cleanup retain the manifest parent through lock acquisition, reads, payload deletion, metadata replacement and lock release. Payload deletion also uses a retained parent. A replaced directory refuses acknowledgement; restoring the original directory permits retry without a stale writer lock.

build.command: env NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 DSH_GATE_CONCURRENCY=2 pnpm run build

docs.command: env NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 DSH_GATE_CONCURRENCY=3 pnpm run test:docs

limitations: This is verification of named Linux path-replacement scenarios, not a complete cross-platform filesystem guarantee.
